newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 3.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Tuesday edged up slightly despite stable cargo levels, traders said. But indications were far apart with majors reported selling 180-cst at $130 while trades by independents were around $126-$127. Volumes transacted were thin with sellers citing choppy weather and high offers. MDO and gasoil firmed with cargo levels.
